experiment.name: Contact continuity fix · preloaded vs preloaded + CRM notes
experiment.hypothesis: Pre-registered targeted development test: explicit contact-scoped CRM persistence/retrieval should repair cross-session service recall. Primary diagnostic: remember-service recall and session-1 note persistence across three repeats; context group checks contact isolation and updated preferences. Full-suite paired comparison and critical policy/control regressions are guardrails. A is the existing preloaded configuration; B adds only contact-continuity instructions. Both use identical preloaded policy, Haiku 4.5, memory off, CRM, Claude-played customer, frozen 20 scenarios x 3 repetitions, and corrected policy-grounding-v2 evaluator. No scenario, policy, harness, SMS-only or model changes. This reused development suite is not independent holdout evidence; three repeats of one recall case cannot establish general recall reliability.
